title: Norwegian Lamb Wrap
description: A warm and wholesome Norwegian-inspired lamb wrap, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. This recipe combines the flavors of Norway with the convenience of a wrap.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer the lamb mixture for 10 minutes.
Warm the tortilla in the microwave for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the lamb mixture onto the tortilla and topping with cilantro.
